newsitem.title: CANADA: BCI acquires control of Canbras.
newsitem.headline: BCI acquires control of Canbras.

text.p: BCE unit Bell Canada International Inc said on Friday that it acquired a majority equity stake in Canbras Communications Corp.
The acquisition was made through the exercise of conversion and exchange rights under a subscription between Canbras and BCI dated June 14, 1995, as amended, BCI said.

On Thursday's completion, BCI through a subsidiary owned 52.12 percent of the issued and outstanding shares of Canbras. BCI also said it held voting control over an additional 105,726 common shares of Canbras through a third party.

BCI said it also agreed on Thursday with a third party, entitling BCI to acquire an additional 300,000 common shares of Canbras. This share acquisition was expected to be completed by June 19, BCI said.

Through its subsidiary, BCI has the right to nominate a majority of the board of Canbras and to subscribe for additional shares to maintain a 51 percent interest on a fully diluted basis in the event that new shares are issued by Canbras.

Canbras owns a 64 percent interest in the Brazilian cable television company Canbras TVA Cabo Ltda, in a partnership with TVA, a Brazilian pay television company. The Brazilian operating company is developing CATV networks in 10 cities containing about 1 million households located adjacent to the city of Sao Paulo, BCI said.
Canbras was also positioned to acquire a majority interest in a company providing telephony services to 70,000 Brazilian subscribers in condominiums, BCI said.
